text:
Sara: Quick heads up — launching the retargeting sweep tomorrow 9am PT. Need final creative set + 2 price-anchor variants. Target CPA 18-20%, budget ramp +30% over first 48h. Can we lock assets by EOD? :clock4:

Mike: On it. Sending the final 6 carousels in 20m. Do we want 7/14/30-day windows or compress to 7/30?

Asha: 7/14/30 preferred for learning. 14 helps with mid-funnel. Also we should add a high-intent segment (product page > cart) with tighter bids.

Ben: Agree on segment. For budget pacing I suggest staged increases: +10% at T0, +10% at 24h, +10% at 48h. If CPA spikes >25% rollback to base immediately.

Olivia: Landing page split — webinar sign-up vs. blog gating. Webinar traffic should go to /webinar?utm_campaign=retarget_sprint. Blog traffic to /product-guide. I'll update LP variants and put tracking.

Sara: Perfect. Ads-bot, schedule the rollout and monitor CPA/CTR alerts.

ads-bot: campaign-scheduler: Rollout scheduled for 2024-10-15T16:00:00Z. Monitoring hook attached: /alerts/marketing/retarget-sprint. Will post hourly summary.

Mike: Creative checklist: 1) 6 carousel images (1200x628) 2) 2 price-anchor headlines 3) three short body copies (<=90 chars) 4) CTR tracking pixel. Sending files to Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/ads/retarget-sprint-assets

Asha: Quick copy options (pick 1 per creative):
- "Still thinking? Save 10% today — limited."
- "Back to finish? See new features."
- "Customers love how X speeds up Y."

Ben: Bidding params (to pass to campaign API):
```
{
  "bid_strategy": "target_cpa",
  "target_cpa": 0.18,
  "budget": 1200,
  "ramp_schedule": [10,10,10],
  "audience_windows": [7,14,30],
  "high_intent_multiplier": 1.25
}
```

Sara: Looks good. One more ask — add UTM template with creative_id and audience window. Use: `?utm_source=paid&utm_medium=retarget&utm_campaign=retarget_sprint&utm_content={{creative_id}}_{{audience}}`

Olivia: I'll wire the LP and analytics. Ben, can you add a guard that pauses high-intent segment if spend >40% of daily budget before 18h?

Ben: Yup, I'll add a rule in the campaign manager. Syntax: `pause_if(spend_pct>40 && hours_since_start<18)`

Mike: Uploading creatives now. ETA 18:10 PT.

Sara: Thanks team — final check at 8pm PT. If everything is green we go live tomorrow. :thumbsup: 

ads-bot: hourly-report: first health check scheduled T+1h. Will report CPA/CTR/Impressions in #marketing.

Olivia: FYI — QA note: make sure pixel fires on both 302 and 301 redirects, we saw issues last month.

Asha: Noted. I'll run a quick smoke test after Mike's upload.

Mike: Upload complete. Files: 6_carousels_v3.zip (link in Drive).

Sara: Great — locking creative set. Moving to final rollout checklist. Thanks all! :rocket:
